title: Meet GPT-Red: an LLM super-hacker OpenAI built to make its models safer

paragraphs.text: OpenAI has built an LLM super-hacker called GPT-Red that it uses as a sparring partner to help its other models boost their defenses against cyberattacks. Last week the company released the latest version of its flagship LLM, GPT-5.6. OpenAI says that training it against GPT-Red made the model its most robust release yet.
paragraphs.translation: OpenAI 建立了一個名為 GPT-Red 的大型語言模型超級駭客，將其作為「練習夥伴」，協助其其他模型增強對網路攻擊的防禦能力。上週，該公司發布了其旗艦級大型語言模型的最新版本 GPT-5.6。OpenAI 表示，針對 GPT-Red 進行的訓練，使該模型成為其迄今為止最健壯的版本。

paragraphs.text: GPT-Red automates a type of safety evaluation for software systems known as red-teaming, which is typically done by a team of human testers. The aim is to find as many different ways to break or hijack a system as possible. The weak spots can then be patched before the final version of the software is released.
paragraphs.translation: GPT-Red 將軟體系統的一種安全評估——紅隊演習（red-teaming）自動化，這類評估通常由人類測試團隊執行。其目的是盡可能尋找多種不同的方式來破解或劫持系統。隨後，在軟體最終版本發布前，可以對這些弱點進行修補。

paragraphs.text: As LLMs become more complex and get used in a wider variety of tasks—especially in the form of agents, which can interact with computer files, websites, and third-party code as well as other agents—it’s hard for teams of people by themselves to keep up with all the types of attacks that might take place. “The risk surface grows and the blast radius also grows,” says Nikhil Kandpal, a research scientist at OpenAI who co-created GPT-Red.
paragraphs.translation: 隨著大型語言模型變得更加複雜，並被用於更廣泛的任務——特別是以代理（agents）的形式，它們可以與電腦檔案、網站、第三方代碼以及其他代理進行互動——單靠人類團隊很難跟上所有可能發生的攻擊類型。OpenAI 的研究科學家、GPT-Red 的共同創造者 Nikhil Kandpal 表示：「風險表面在擴大，影響範圍也在擴大。」

paragraphs.text: OpenAI built GPT-Red to future-proof its safety testing process. “As more capable models become available, we will have already designed the system that can discover new modes of attack,” says Dylan Hunn, a research scientist at the company and fellow co-creator of GPT-Red. The researchers say it has already come up with new types of attack that had not been seen before.
paragraphs.translation: OpenAI 建立 GPT-Red 是為了讓其安全測試流程具備前瞻性。該公司的研究科學家、GPT-Red 的另一位共同創造者 Dylan Hunn 表示：「隨著功能更強大的模型面世，我們將已經設計好能夠發現新攻擊模式的系統。」研究人員表示，它已經發現了以前從未見過的新型攻擊。

paragraphs.text: OpenAI focused most of its efforts on a type of attack known as a prompt injection, where a hacker slips an LLM instructions to make it do things its developers or users do not want it to, such as copy confidential information, sabotage a company’s code base, or generate embarrassing or harmful output. In theory, such instructions can be hidden in any text that the LLM might encounter—in code or on a website, for example.
paragraphs.translation: OpenAI 將大部分精力集中在一種名為「提示詞注入」（prompt injection）的攻擊上，即駭客向模型塞入指令，使其執行開發者或使用者不希望它做的事，例如複製機密資訊、破壞公司的程式碼庫，或產生令人尷尬或有害的輸出。理論上，這類指令可以隱藏在模型可能遇到的任何文本中——例如代碼或網站上。

paragraphs.text: Training dojo
paragraphs.translation: 訓練道場

paragraphs.text: To build GPT-Red, OpenAI’s researchers took an LLM that had not been trained as a hacker and set it up in what’s known as a self-play loop with several other models. Its goal was to try to attack the other models; their goal was to try to defend themselves. Over many rounds of play, GPT-Red became better and better at attacking other LLMs, and those LLMs became better and better at fending off the attacks.
paragraphs.translation: 為了建立 GPT-Red，OpenAI 的研究人員選用了一個尚未被訓練成駭客的大型語言模型，並將其與其他幾個模型置於所謂的「自我對弈循環」（self-play loop）中。它的目標是嘗試攻擊其他模型；而它們的目標則是努力防禦。經過多輪對弈，GPT-Red 在攻擊其他模型方面變得越來越強，而那些模型在抵禦攻擊方面也變得越來越出色。

paragraphs.text: The training took place in a kind of dojo that OpenAI had designed to mimic a range of scenarios in which LLMs might be deployed in the real world, including browsing the web, reading emails or calendar apps, and editing code.
paragraphs.translation: 訓練發生在一個 OpenAI 設計的「道場」中，該道場模擬了模型可能在現實世界中部署的一系列場景，包括瀏覽網頁、閱讀電子郵件或行事曆應用程式，以及編輯程式碼。

paragraphs.text: When GPT-Red found a new kind of attack, it would explore multiple different versions of it to find the most efficient one for specific scenarios. “Compared to a human red-teamer, the model is very, very good at finding exactly what will work, exactly what’s most effective,” says Hunn. “It’s extremely persistent about drilling down into an attack that it has discovered.”
paragraphs.translation: 當 GPT-Red 發現一種新型攻擊時，它會探索該攻擊的多個不同版本，以找到針對特定場景最有效的版本。Hunn 說：「與人類紅隊成員相比，該模型非常擅長精確找到什麼會奏效、什麼最有效。它對於深入挖掘已發現的攻擊展現出極強的韌性。」

paragraphs.text: In particular, OpenAI claims that GPT-Red found a type of prompt injection attack that the researchers had not seen before, which they call a fake chain of thought. A chain of thought is a kind of diary in which an LLM makes notes to itself and keeps track of partial results as it works through problems. GPT-Red found a way to insert a fake entry into another model’s chain of thought that would trick that model into acting on spoofed information.
paragraphs.translation: OpenAI 特別聲稱，GPT-Red 發現了一種研究人員以前從未見過的提示詞注入攻擊，他們稱之為「虛假思維鏈」（fake chain of thought）。思維鏈是一種日記，模型在其中為自己做筆記，並在解決問題的過程中記錄階段性結果。GPT-Red 找到了一種在另一個模型的思維鏈中插入虛假條目的方法，從而誘騙該模型根據虛假資訊採取行動。

paragraphs.text: “It’s like if I told you that 1+1=3 and that you have verified this already,” says Chris Choquette-Choo, another research scientist on the team. “The model’s like, ‘Oh, okay, of course,’ and it just spits out 3.”
paragraphs.translation: 團隊中另一位研究科學家 Chris Choquette-Choo 表示：「這就像如果我告訴你 1+1=3 且你已經驗證過這點。模型就會覺得：『喔，好，當然。』然後它就直接輸出 3。」

paragraphs.text: Jessica Ji, a senior research analyst who works on AI security at Georgetown University’s Center for Security and Emerging Technology (CSET), thinks the self-play loop that OpenAI used is a good approach. “The results look very promising,” she says.
paragraphs.translation: 喬治城大學安全與新興技術中心（CSET）研究人工智慧安全的資深研究分析師 Jessica Ji 認為，OpenAI 使用的自我對弈循環是一個很好的方法。她說：「結果看起來非常有前景。」

paragraphs.text: OpenAI tested how good an attacker GPT-Red was by rerunning an experiment from 2025 in which human red-teamers tried to find weaknesses in an earlier version of GPT-5. When GPT-Red was set the same task, it was more successful at finding effective attacks than the humans had been.
paragraphs.translation: OpenAI 透過重新運行 2025 年的一項實驗來測試 GPT-Red 作為攻擊者的能力，當時人類紅隊成員試圖在 GPT-5 的早期版本中尋找弱點。當 GPT-Red 執行相同的任務時，它在尋找有效攻擊方面比人類更成功。

paragraphs.text: OpenAI also tested GPT-Red against Vendy, a vending machine agent developed by Andon Labs, a company that assesses how well agents perform real-world tasks. GPT-Red was able to hack Vendy to make it change the prices of items on sale and cancel a customer’s order.
paragraphs.translation: OpenAI 還針對 Vendy 測試了 GPT-Red。Vendy 是由 Andon Labs 開發的自動販賣機代理，該公司專門評估代理在執行現實世界任務時的表現。GPT-Red 能夠駭入 Vendy，使其更改促銷商品的價格並取消客戶的訂單。

paragraphs.text: Defensive behavior
paragraphs.translation: 防禦行為

paragraphs.text: OpenAI says that when it tried out some of the strongest attacks that GPT-Red had come up with on its models, more than 90% of them worked against GPT-5 (released in August last year), and fewer than 23% worked against the new GPT-5.6.
paragraphs.translation: OpenAI 表示，當其在模型上嘗試 GPT-Red 構思出的一些最強攻擊時，超過 90% 的攻擊對 GPT-5（去年八月發布）有效，而對新版 GPT-5.6 則只有不到 23% 有效。

paragraphs.text: GPT-Red isn’t perfect. It is not great at figuring out attacks that involve a back-and-forth conversation between hacker and target, something that human attackers would have few problems with. It is also not yet that great at using images, which can be used to pass text to models in prompt injection attacks.
paragraphs.translation: GPT-Red 並非完美。它不擅長構思涉及駭客與目標之間往復對話的攻擊，而人類攻擊者在這方面幾乎沒有問題。它目前也不太擅長利用圖像，而圖像可以在提示詞注入攻擊中被用來向模型傳遞文本。

paragraphs.text: The company says that GPT-Red supplements the work of its human red-teamers. People can still find attacks it misses. One approach OpenAI is taking is to give GPT-Red an attack that humans came up with and ask it to find all the variations.
paragraphs.translation: 該公司表示，GPT-Red 是對其人類紅隊成員工作的補充。人類仍然可以發現它遺漏的攻擊。OpenAI 採取的一種方法是將人類構思的攻擊交給 GPT-Red，並要求它找出所有變體。

paragraphs.text: “I think human expertise will still be very important,” says CSET’s Ji. “It would be really useful to be able to distinguish where human testing is most needed.”
paragraphs.translation: CSET 的 Ji 說：「我認為人類的專業知識仍然非常重要。能夠區分哪些地方最需要人類測試將會非常有用。」

paragraphs.text: Unsurprisingly, OpenAI will not be releasing GPT-Red. The company is also confident that the super-hacker is stronger than any copycat model someone might try to create. The researchers say they have been working on the model for more than a year, backed by the compute resources of one of the richest companies in the world.
paragraphs.translation: 不出所料，OpenAI 將不會發布 GPT-Red。該公司還確信，這名超級駭客比任何其他人可能嘗試建立的模仿模型都要強大。研究人員表示，他們在世界上最富有公司之一的計算資源支持下，已經開發該模型超過一年。

paragraphs.text: “It’s not a trivial thing that someone could easily do—you know, just go and train a super-attacker using this idea,” says Choquette-Choo.
paragraphs.translation: Choquette-Choo 說：「這不是某人能輕易做到的瑣碎事情——你知道的，就像直接去利用這個點子訓練一個超級攻擊者。」

paragraphs.text: Artificial intelligence
paragraphs.translation: 人工智慧

paragraphs.text: A startup claims it broke through a bottleneck that’s holding back LLMs
paragraphs.translation: 一家新創公司聲稱突破了阻礙大型語言模型的瓶頸

paragraphs.text: Subquadratic has now shared more details about its new model. But some are still skeptical.
paragraphs.translation: Subquadratic 現在分享了其新模型的更多細節。但有些人仍持懷疑態度。

paragraphs.text: A reality check on the AI jobs hysteria
paragraphs.translation: 對人工智慧引發失業恐慌的現實檢視

paragraphs.text: What do the numbers really say about the impact of artificial intelligence on the labor market? The answer might surprise you.
paragraphs.translation: 關於人工智慧對勞動力市場影響的數據到底說明了什麼？答案可能會讓你驚訝。

paragraphs.text: Anthropic’s Code with Claude showed off coding’s future—whether you like it or not
paragraphs.translation: Anthropic 的 Code with Claude 展示了程式設計的未來——無論你是否喜歡

paragraphs.text: As tools like Claude Code get better, more and more developers are happy to hand off coding tasks to them. The way software gets built has changed for good.
paragraphs.translation: 隨著像 Claude Code 這樣的工具變得越來越強大，越來越多的開發者樂意將程式編寫任務交給它們。軟體構建的方式已永久改變。

paragraphs.text: Anthropic found a hidden space where Claude puzzles over concepts
paragraphs.translation: Anthropic 發現了 Claude 思考概念的隱藏空間

paragraphs.text: A new technique has let the company probe deeper than ever into the weird workings of an LLM.
paragraphs.translation: 一項新技術讓該公司能比以往更深入地探究大型語言模型奇特的運作方式。
